vocabulary.meaning_en: to have information from facts, watching, or asking; also to have a relationship with someone
vocabulary.note_ar: I have known her for five years = أعرفها منذ خمس سنوات (علاقة)
vocabulary.note_en: "I have known her for five years" = we have a relationship.
vocabulary.example: I have known my best friend since school.
We learn through observation and inquiry.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to accept that something is true or valid
vocabulary.example: I recognize that your idea has some merit.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the quality of being true or reasonable
vocabulary.example: There is some validity in what you say.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that you accept or notice something
your way of seeing something; your point of view
vocabulary.note_ar: from my perspective = من وجهة نظري
vocabulary.example: From my perspective, that's an interesting point.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be thankful for something and see its value
vocabulary.example: I appreciate you telling me that.
Think about the implications of missing the train.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to get the real, intended meaning of something
vocabulary.note_ar: أعمق من know: تفهم المقصود وليس المعلومة فقط
vocabulary.note_en: Deeper than know: you get the intended meaning.
vocabulary.example: I understand. I'll try to be on time from now on.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to see or notice; to understand in a certain way
vocabulary.example: He didn't want to be perceived as arrogant.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what the speaker really wants to say
vocabulary.example: Listen for the intended meaning, not just the words.

vocabulary.meaning_en: thinking you are better or know more than others
vocabulary.example: Saying "I know, I know" can sound arrogant.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a slow movement that is not direct; the general meaning of what someone says
vocabulary.note_ar: I catch your drift = فهمت ما ترمي إليه
vocabulary.note_en: I catch your drift = I understand your general meaning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to read or judge something wrongly
vocabulary.example: I misread the menu; I thought it said chicken and fish.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to confuse two things; to put them in the wrong place
vocabulary.example: I mixed up the two markers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not able to think clearly or understand
vocabulary.note_ar: confuse A with B = يخلط بين أ وب

fine_lines.title: know vs understand
fine_lines.explanation_ar: know تعني أن لديك المعلومة (تعرف كيف تستخدم الهاتف). understand تعني أنك تفهم المعنى العميق وكيف يعمل الشيء (تستطيع تركيب الهاتف). وفي الحوار، I understand تُظهر أنك فهمت ما يقصده الآخر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Know = you have the information (you can use a phone). Understand = you get the deeper meaning or how it works (you could build it). In conversation, "I understand" shows you got the person's intended meaning.

examples.sentence: I know how to use this phone.
I understand why you are worried.

fine_lines.title: misread vs misunderstand vs mix up vs confused
fine_lines.explanation_ar: misread: قرأت أو رأيت الشيء خطأً. misunderstand: فهمت المقصود خطأً. mix up: بدّلت بين شيئين. confused: تفكيري غير واضح.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Misread: you read or judged it wrongly. Misunderstand: you got the wrong idea. Mix up: you swapped two things. Confused: your thinking is not clear.

examples.sentence: I misread the time on the ticket.
I mixed up the two cups.

expressions.meaning_en: I accept there is truth in what you said.
expressions.example: I recognize that the weather is bad today.

expressions.meaning_en: I know what you mean, but I see it differently.
expressions.example: From my perspective, the plan needs more time.

expressions.phrase: I appreciate you telling me that.
expressions.meaning_en: Thank you; this information is valuable to me.
expressions.example: The train leaves early? I appreciate you telling me that.
If I'm late again I could lose my job? I understand.
So this switch controls the lights? I see.

expressions.meaning_en: auditory style: I got your message
expressions.example: I don't like the sound of that. - I hear what you're saying.

expressions.phrase: I get the picture. / I see what you mean.
expressions.meaning_en: visual style: I can see your idea
expressions.example: A red sweater with a hood? I get the picture.

expressions.meaning_en: movement style: I understand your general meaning
expressions.example: You want me to leave early? I catch your drift.

expressions.phrase: throw the baby out with the bathwater
expressions.meaning_ar: يتخلّص من الشيء الجيد مع السيئ
expressions.meaning_en: to lose something good while removing something bad
expressions.example: Don't stop saying "know" completely; don't throw the baby out with the bathwater.

grammar.title: Match the speaker's style: hear / see / feel
grammar.explanation_ar: الناس يتكلمون بأسلوب سمعي أو بصري أو حركي. إذا قال المتحدث That sounds... فأجب بعبارة سمعية: I hear what you're saying. وإذا قال That looks... فأجب بعبارة بصرية: I see what you mean. هذا يقوّي التواصل.
grammar.explanation_en: People speak in sound, picture or movement styles. If someone says "That sounds...", answer "I hear what you're saying". If they say "That looks...", answer "I see what you mean". Matching their style improves communication.
examples: I don't like the sound of that. - I hear what you're saying.
That looks good. - I see what you mean.
Do you get it? - Yes, I catch your drift.
